basic_info.description: Ocean lovers check out this Bright inviting corner home move in ready! Enjoy Ocean Views from the kitchen and one of the bedrooms. Just blocks from the beach. Some updates have been done, such as double pane windows, updated kitchen and beautiful bathroom. The flooring throughout done in a modern laminate wood style very striking and beachcomber feel.  The convenience of a corner store across the street to the muni stop make this such an easy place to call home. Lower level Bonus room perfect office, hobby or workout room. There is wet bar and full modern bath. Back patio or extra parking as there is a curb cut and gate. Ample parking in the deep garage and driveway for a small car. Washer and dryer included. Fresh paint inside main level and exterior. Roof maintenance just done.
